history.p: The University of Copenhagen started planning their four hundredth anniversary during the summer of 1878. The Senate wanted two cantatas: one for the feast of conferring degrees at the University, and one for the ceremony in Vor Frue Kirke. Niels W. Gade and Christian Richardt were asked to write the former, whereas Hartmann as the long standing organist of Vor Frue Kirke was obliged to compose the latter cantata in collaboration with Carl Ploug.
